title: Post: add CRLF output, linear travel, XY programBounds, and generic waterjet dialect hooks

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Extend the post engine and intermediate CL stream for abrasive-waterjet dialects, and ship a clean-room generic ISO waterjet post.

Depends on #1881 (`waterjet` machine kind and `Waterjet` tool kind).

## Scope

- **Post engine (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/js.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs`):**
  - Add an optional `lineEnding` manifest flag (`"lf"` default, `"crlf"` for `\r\n` output) in `js.rs` and `engine.rs` (lines 528–532 write only `\n` today).
  - Publish linear axis `travel` bounds in `script_props()` (`crates/post/src/post/machine.rs`) alongside rotary travel.
  - Compute the cut XY bounding box (`programBounds`: `minX`, `maxX`, `minY`, `maxY` from `move_extremes`) before `onOpen` runs.
- **Intermediate CL stream and JS hooks (`crates/cl/src/`, `crates/post/src/post/`):**
  - Add waterjet section and span records (`WaterjetCut`, `JetSpan`) with jet/abrasive enable, pierce dwell, valve lag dwell, and cut role without coupling to plasma THC (`PlasmaRec`, `TorchRec`).
  - Add `onJetOn` and `onJetOff` script hooks.
  - Support optional arc linearization (`linearizeArcs` / chord tolerance using `Move::chords`) for controllers without `G2`/`G3`.
- **Generic ISO abrasive-waterjet post (`assets/posts/`):**
  - Add a clean-room generic waterjet `.cps` post (`G20`/`G21`, `G90`, `G0`/`G1` or `G2`/`G3`, water and abrasive M-code properties, `G4` pierce dwell).
  - Refuse spindle words (`S` RPM, `G95`/`G96`) and non-waterjet sections by name.

**Done means:** the post engine emits CRLF when requested, exposes linear axis travel and XY `programBounds` to scripts, serializes waterjet CL records cleanly, and pins a golden generic waterjet `.nc` output plus dialect refusals in tests.

Part of #1525
